title: Final Answer for π+
description: Essential Criteria: The student must provide the correct expression for the collision cross section for π+ as σ = π b^2 (T - V)/T.

title: Final Answer for π-
description: Essential Criteria: The student must provide the correct expression for the collision cross section for π- as σ = π b^2 (T + V)/T.

title: Energy Conservation
description: Important Criteria: The student should correctly apply conservation of energy to relate T, V, and the angular momentum.

title: Angular Momentum Conservation
description: Important Criteria: The student must demonstrate the correct application of angular momentum conservation in the context of the problem.

title: Correct Potential V
description: Optional Criteria: The student should correctly identify and substitute the potential V = Ze^2/b for the π+ case and V = -Ze^2/b for the π- case.

title: Impact Parameter Definition
description: Optional Criteria: The student should define the impact parameter d and its significance in the context of the collision.

title: Sign Mistakes
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must avoid sign mistakes when substituting the potential V for π+ and π-.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should ensure that all units are consistent throughout the derivation.
